name: toaster

definition.en: a small electric machine that makes bread brown and crisp
definition.tr: ekmeği kızartıp gevrekleştiren küçük elektrikli makine
definition.de: ein kleines Elektrogerät, das Brot bräunt und knusprig macht
definition.fr: un petit appareil électrique qui dore et rend le pain croustillant
definition.it: un piccolo apparecchio elettrico che rende il pane dorato e croccante
definition.es: un pequeño aparato eléctrico que dora el pan y lo deja crujiente

origin: toast (Old French toster ← Latin tostus, roasted) + -er

sentences.en: Put two slices of bread in the [toaster].
sentences.tr: Ekmek kızartma makinesine iki dilim ekmek koy.
sentences.de: Steck zwei Scheiben Brot in den Toaster.
sentences.fr: Mets deux tranches de pain dans le grille-pain.
sentences.it: Metti due fette di pane nel tostapane.
sentences.es: Pon dos rebanadas de pan en la tostadora.

sentences.de: Der Toaster hat mein Brot schon wieder verbrannt.
sentences.fr: Le grille-pain a encore brûlé mon pain.
sentences.it: Il tostapane mi ha bruciato di nuovo il pane.
sentences.es: La tostadora me ha vuelto a quemar el pan.

sentences.en: The hotel had a [toaster] at the breakfast buffet.
sentences.tr: Otelin kahvaltı büfesinde ekmek kızartma makinesi vardı.
sentences.de: Im Hotel stand ein Toaster am Frühstücksbuffet.
sentences.fr: L'hôtel avait un grille-pain au buffet du petit-déjeuner.
sentences.it: L'albergo aveva un tostapane al buffet della colazione.
sentences.es: El hotel tenía una tostadora en el bufé del desayuno.
